purpose: Teach: 抹殺/卑劣/撃退/狙撃/弛緩/摂理/拘置/朝方

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合を抹殺するのではなく共存を狙え
lines.en: I want this company to coexist with our competitors—not eliminate them.
lines.style: Measured authority. Clipped articulation on key words. No wasted breath. Leans forward slightly, eyes steady on the listener. A principle being stated, not debated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。卑劣な業界慣行は社内で禁止しております
lines.en: Yes. We've already prohibited unethical industry practices internally.
lines.style: Attentive, careful enunciation. Not defensive—just precise. A nod of confirmation embedded in the tone. Professional formality with a thread of genuine agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、サイバー攻撃を撃退するシステムを強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our cybersecurity systems to defend against attacks.
lines.style: Directive, no inflection for negotiation. Sharp attack on the opening syllable. Brief pause after the command, letting the weight of it settle. Voice stays level and final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への狙撃的なクレーム対応も準備します
lines.en: Yes. We're also preparing targeted support protocols for our key clients.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly faster pace than before. Slight upturn at the end of the first clause—showing he's been thinking ahead. Alert, anticipatory tone. Ready to move.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の弛緩した態度を引き締めろ
lines.en: Tighten up the discipline among staff. I'm seeing complacency.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Weight on 'tighten'—a real expectation here. Controlled irritation underneath, delivered without heat. Eyes narrowing slightly as he speaks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の摂理に従いつつ独自路線も追求します
lines.en: Yes. We're reviewing our approach—staying responsive to market demands while charting our own course.
lines.style: Thoughtful, matching his pace. Slight hesitation before the second clause—weighing the balance of two competing priorities. Respectful but showing some independence of thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、容疑のかかった役員を拘置当局に協力させろ
lines.en: Ensure full cooperation with authorities regarding any executives under investigation.
lines.style: Stone-still delivery. No emotion. Each word deliberate and separated slightly. Final word spoken with absolute finality. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。朝方の業務開始時間を見直しております
lines.en: Understood. We're also reviewing our morning start times and work schedules.
lines.style: Quieter, more deferential close. Slight deflection in tone—a small shift in topic. Professional but signaling the end of the conversation. Respectful distance.
